text:
alert-bot: :rotating_light: GPU ECC rate spike + node crash detected in eu-south-1, rack r12. Impacting Dedicated pool eu-south-a. Auto-drain kicked in for some pods.

maria: seeing degraded capacity, tails of latency on inference routes (p95 up ~ 320ms) and queueing on batch jobs. Any estimate on spare nodes?

kevin: oncall here — checking capacity. eu-west has ~20% spare but cross-region soft-failover still needs routing change. Can we shift some traffic?

aj: we can route low-priority batch and non-sensitive hosted requests to eu-west. Want to avoid routing private-dedicated customers.

lee: hw logs show repeated correctable ECC followed by an uncorrectable. Node gw-r12-n5 kernel saw PCIe AER then OOM, then host reboot. suspect thermal throttle + riser issue.

maria: can we isolate that rack and drain the remainder before it compacts more jobs?

kevin: I'm going to run the drain for affected node set: `redwoodctl nodes list --rack r12 --status degraded` then `redwoodctl nodes drain --id gw-r12-n5 --reason "ECC surge" --wait 10m`

aj: fyi, batching config for dedicated pools uses max_batch=32; when we lost that node batch windows widened. I'll temporarily lower batching for eu-south to reduce token latency while we shift.

oncall-sre: started a canary traffic shift of 10% non-SLA traffic to eu-west via routing-policy v2. Monitoring now.

cloud-support: we've contacted provider NIC team, opened ticket PRJ-9876, they're provisioning hardware tech. ETA for hands-on RMA: ~8 hours.

lee: ordering an emergency riser replacement and spare GPU from inventory til RMA completes. hw-logistics assigned.

hw-logistics: spare shipment arranged, ETA to colo 6 hours. We'll stage replacement once rack is clear.

maria: quick status check: what else needs draining? Could be other nodes in the same PSU chain.

lee: running quick health scan across r12, found 2 nodes with rising ECC counts: gw-r12-n3 and gw-r12-n7. I'll mark them for proactive drain after confirming current tasks.

kevin: timeline: drain gw-r12-n5 started 1995001300, expected complete by 1995001500. Routing shift ramping to 30% by 1995001600 if metrics look ok.

aj: posting the drain command for followups:
```
# drain node safely
redwoodctl nodes cordon gw-r12-n5
redwoodctl nodes drain gw-r12-n5 --grace-period 300 --force-if-stuck
# move running containers 
redwoodctl scheduler migrate --from-node gw-r12-n5 --to-pool eu-west-a --policy best-effort
```

maria: noted, monitoring token-level cost and latency in Console. If p90 > 250ms on hosted we revert.

oncall-sre: currently seeing increased error-rate on dedicated route d/eu-south/model-qa: 0.8% -> 2.1%. Keeping alerts on.

cloud-support: provider confirms host liveness issues due to thermal event. They recommend disabling NVLink on that node until hardware swapped.

lee: will disable NVLink and power-cycle once node is drained. Doing it at 1995001400.

kevin: can someone post recent dmesg snippet for gw-r12-n5 for postmortem?

lee: pasting last 10 lines:
```
[ 1312.345678] pcieport 0000:01:00.0: AER: Uncorrected (Non-Fatal) error received: id=0000
[ 1312.345681] nvme nvme0: pci eerr: device status 0x70
[ 1312.345683] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:81:00): 13, pid 12345, 0ffffffff
[ 1312.345690] GPU 0000:81:00: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[ 1312.345700] thermal thermal_zone0: critical temp reached
[ 1312.345740] kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 4123 (java) score 1071
```

aj: thanks — that aligns with the observed OOM during IO stall. We'll capture full logs to the incident doc.

maria: what's plan for customer notification? Any Dedicated customers in eu-south impacted?

kevin: customer-success already pinged customers on affected dedicated pools. CS will follow up with status page entry if we escalate past 2 hours.

oncall-sre: metrics look stable after ramp to 30%, p95 down to 260ms. Continue to monitor while we proceed with rack evacuation.

lee: starting marked-node drains for gw-r12-n3 and gw-r12-n7 at 1995002000, will stagger to keep capacity.

hw-logistics: tagging replacement parts in inventory thread INV-4312. If provider RMA arrives earlier we pull and cancel shipment.

maria: small note — cost side: cross-region egress for batch reroute will increase spend. I'll estimate incremental for billing: rough calc ~ $120/day at current volume.

aj: turned on temporary cache for embeddings route in eu-south to reduce downstream tokens; should shave some cost.

kevin: summary for incident timeline so far: root cause thermal spike -> ECC escalation -> GPU offbus -> OOM -> node crash; we drained node, disabled NVLink, staged replacements, routing shifted to eu-west for low-priority traffic, CS notified.

maria: thanks. If all stable we'll keep this thread open for postmortem notes and close when hardware replaced and rack fully green. :thumbsup:

alert-bot: Incident updated: status -> mitigated. Ticket PRJ-9876 link: https://provider.status/PRJ-9876
